record.change_summary: Issued under Article 16 of Regulation (EU) No 1093/2010 pursuant to the mandate in Articles 87a(1), 87a(5) and 74 of Directive 2013/36/EU (CRD), these comply-or-explain guidelines set minimum standards and reference methodologies for institutions' identification, measurement, management and monitoring of environmental, social and governance (ESG) risks, including materiality assessment, data processes, integration into risk management (risk appetite, credit/market/liquidity/operational/reputational/concentration risk policies), and the content of Article 76(2) CRD transition plans. They apply to institutions other than SNCIs from 11 January 2026 and to SNCIs at the latest from 11 January 2027.
